pages.text: A shock for fibrillation or after a CPR cycle ($(cfg)30$() s). Success ~$(cfg)70%%$(). On a beating heart — a burn and arrhythmia.
Adrenaline (pen): raises pressure, helps restart the heart; numbs pain for $(cfg)30–60$() s.
Revival fails? Check the panel for what blocks it: too little blood, tension pneumothorax, no CPR. A hint appears after an attempt.
